description.mn: Acqua di Parma Vaniglia: Unisex гурман үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: гелиотроп, нероли, бергамот, мандарин; зүрхний ноот: жасмин, ваниль; суурь ноот: хуш мод, заар.
description.en: Vaniglia Eau de Parfum, crafted by Acqua di Parma, presents a captivating Amber fragrance suitable for both women and men. Introduced in 2019, this scent opens with vibrant top notes of Heliotrope, Neroli, Calabrian bergamot, and Mandarin Orange. At its heart lie enchanting notes of Vanilla and Jasmine Sambac, while the fragrance concludes with a warm base of Cedar and Musk. Vaniglia is a sun-filled interpretation of vanilla's intriguing and fascinating notes. The sweet essence of vanilla is extracted from the cloves and combined with notes of bergamot, mandarin, neroli and jasmine sambac for an enveloping and warm composition. An artistic combination celebrating Madagascar's precious essence. KEY NOTES:
